customManagers.description: ARG PROWLARR_VERSION and the ARG PROWLARR_COMMIT beneath it, captured together so one PR moves both. The dockerfile manager only reads an ARG that a FROM expands, and these feed the fetch stage's checkout. Prowlarr tags every develop build as well as every stable release, and publishes the develop ones as GitHub pre-releases, so only a release GitHub calls stable is offered. github-releases lists releases alone, so a tag with no release is never offered either, and a failed lookup offers nothing, where github-tags offers every tag it cannot find a pre-release for. Its digest is the commit the release's tag names, which the fetch stage checks out and asserts the tag still names. github-releases finds that commit by the tag's own name, v3.0.2.5780, so currentValueTemplate gives the version Renovate compares upstream's v, which extractVersion would strip and so lose the commit, and autoReplaceStringTemplate writes the ARG back without it. The versioning compares all four numbers, which semver cannot read. The two ARGs must stay adjacent and in this order.

packageRules.description: The Prowlarr release merges once every check passes, like every other update here, and majors are no exception: the acceptance suite, not the size of the bump, is what holds a release back.
